title: Announcement Regarding Receipt of the Third-Party Committee's Investigation Report (Final Report) and Our Company's Response
excerpt: The completed investigation identified widespread improper accounting and quantified provisional historical effects.
summary: Nidec's independent committee completed its accounting investigation and identified widespread misconduct. Nidec reported cumulative negative effects through fiscal Q1 2025 of JPY 166.4 billion on operating profit and JPY 160.7 billion on period profit, before possible additional impairment, depreciation and tax effects, and separately estimated USD 69.7 million of U.S. customs duties and interest through September 2025.
